title: Wise Abigail Stops Trouble
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose warmth calms people down, and tonight Abigail rides out with bread and gentle words to stop a battle: Willow brings the kitchen timer and a soft voice to two brothers fighting over a truck.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because her warm words can calm a storm. In Willow’s world today: her two brothers are yelling over whose turn it is with the red truck, and one of them is about to grab. Willow gets the kitchen timer and says softly, “Let’s each have five minutes. You can go first.” The yelling stops, and both boys sit down to wait their turn. Just like wise Abigail, Willow learned that soft, kind words can stop a fight before it starts.
